## Notes

- Appointments are available in 30-minute slots, multiple slots can be booked for longer appointments.
- Contact [ND-HNC staff](../pages/people.qmd) if additional availability (e.g. weekend) is needed.
- Non-MRI rooms require 1 hour of notice for booking, the MRI requires 24 hours.
- Please do not delete your appointment after it occurs, we will use the calendar to track center usage.
- Note the Scheduling [policy](../pages/policies.qmd).
- **Please use the booking buttons (below) to schedule rooms.**

## Zone 1

- Two consultation rooms (B05, B06) are available for participant preparation.
- A conference room (B26) is available for team and project meetings.

## Zone 2

- Two interview rooms (B12, B13) are available for interviews, testing, and participant preparation.
- An MRI Simulator (Mock, B14) is also available to prepare participants for their MRI appointment. This does not have to occur on the same day as the scan.

## Zones 3-4

- An MRI (B17) appointment books Zones 3 and 4.
- Please note the Billing [policy](../pages/policies.qmd).
- **NOTE: Appointments are ONLY confirmed when accepted by the MRI Technologist.**
